item.title: Briefing Builder
item.description:
Most “daily briefing” skills assume you use the same stack as whoever wrote them. Briefing Builder doesn’t. It’s a meta-skill: it interviews you about your tools, role, and what “important” actually means to you — then generates a pair of briefing skills tailored to your setup.

There’s a full write-up of why I built it on the blog: The Briefing Skill That Builds Itself Around You.

What it does

Run it once and it walks you through a short set of questions, then produces two ready-to-install skills:
